sections.heading: Overview

sections.content: To support the delivery of EnergyCo’s program of works through supporting leaders in making informed decisions based on sound economic modelling outcomes and regulatory guidance for the timely authorisation of network infrastructure projects.
sections.heading: Project goals

sections.content: The scope of services include provision of energy market modelling (using PLEXOS or equivalent), cost benefit analysis, and regulatory advisory.
